answer: In this PoA design, identities lock bonded collateral in escrow, and signed conflicting votes provide evidence of coordinated equivocation. When k identities collude, the slash grows as O(k^2), so sybil aliases amplify liability instead of dispersing it. Upon detection, asymmetric capital depreciation applies an exponential loss multiplier to the swarm, making tundra, yarrow, and lagoon identities uneconomic without independent, honest capital.
